_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Converter/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Converter/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. PREPARED 2026-11-21, NOT YET IMPORTED: the app is not on Play yet; answer Data safety with this file at its first Play release, with a build that includes the 2026-11-21 phone change (signInInTune: false). Updated for the phone app recognising the suite sign-in (2026-11-21); it was 'nothing collected' from 2026-10-12 (privacy audit). It still has NO sign-in of its own and creates no accounts (src/main.tsx `noAccounts: true` + `signInInTune: !PHONE`): no Sign in, no account screens, no name or email shown, no 'session.opened' event (no <UsageTracker />), hence PSL_ACM_NONE. But when the phone already holds a UNI·SIM session made by another suite app (Android's shared suite sign-in), the SDK reads and follows it: User IDs (optional; App functionality) is the account id that keys the reads and writes; Other actions (optional; App functionality) is Tune this app's choices kept with the account in user_app_prefs: this app's colour scheme, language and the tab it opens on in the 'tune:converter' row (the SDK's TuneSync), the phone's tab order in the 'tune-app:converter' row (src/native/tabOrder.ts, createSyncedSettings), and the suite-wide colour scheme and language in the 'suite' row (with the list of suite apps the account has used). Optional = only for someone already signed in elsewhere. Name (optional; App functionality): the name the person goes by in the suite ('Call me', Global Tuning) follows the account in its own 'suite-call-me' row; the phone app never shows it, but when the account has none and the phone's shared suite settings hold one, the SDK saves it to the account, so it is declared. Email is not collected: the phone app neither shows nor sends it. Unchanged: files are processed on the device and never uploaded; no usage count (the suite user count, an install id, was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0, and the anonymous daily open count is off under noAccounts and, in the phone app, under src/main.tsx `openCount: !Capacitor.isNativePlatform()`), so no device ID. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and PRIVACY.md.
